text: To quantify supervision effectiveness in their AI-AI experiments, the authors adopt a Performance Recovered (PR) metric 'following the framework established by' Burns et al. (2023). Their PR is the true reward of the Best-of-N sample chosen by a reward model learned from critiques, divided by the oracle best of N samples.
title: Wen et al. adapt Burns et al.'s performance-gap-recovered framework into a Best-of-N PR metric
